title: Computer-use architecture and provenance freeze
objective: Freeze the QDRAL-P18 computer-use architecture and donor provenance without widening authority: pin exact donor commit revisions, record exact reused and reference paths with licenses and reuse classifications, freeze the canonical ComputerActionProposal vocabulary and target identity vocabulary, fix process, IPC, trust, approval, and lease boundaries, record the denied-authority list, and fix the browser-host packaging strategy and Windows provider boundaries. Prove donor code is not independently reachable from MCP or remote interfaces and that no donor parser or backend receives authority-bearing fields.

include: pinned UI-TARS donor revision bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop@2ff41a9e515828c5bd5b276e493d73aa0bdf4a3a with exact reused and reference paths, file and package licenses, required notices, and reuse classifications
canonical ComputerActionProposal vocabulary (proposal data only, never executable authority) and target identity vocabulary
process boundaries, IPC boundaries, and trust, approval, and lease boundaries between Deskal policy kernel and low-authority providers
denied-authority list carried forward from the P18 plan
browser-host packaging strategy and Windows provider boundaries
proof that donor code is not independently reachable from MCP or remote interfaces
exclude: new MCP tools, profiles, or remote authority
any new kernel capability, approval class, trust right, lease right, shell, interpreter, or generic network authority

invariants: architecture work never widens authority to prove a point
model and provider output remains untrusted proposal input
no donor parser or backend receives authority-bearing fields

acceptance.claim: Donor revisions, exact reused and reference paths, licenses, notices, and reuse classifications are recorded and every reused path resolves to its pinned revision.
The ComputerActionProposal vocabulary carries proposal data only, target identities are Deskal-issued, and process, IPC, trust, approval, and lease boundaries are fixed with a denied-authority list.

Donor code is proven unreachable from MCP and remote interfaces, and exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.
